# the one place a python tool run through `uvx` is pinned (#2185). dependabot's
# pip ecosystem bumps these lines (.github/dependabot.yml), and every workflow
# step, hook and doc reads them through `scripts/tool-pin.sh <name>` instead of
# writing `uvx <tool>@<version>` inline, which dependabot cannot see.
# scripts/check-tool-pins.sh fails on an inline pin or an unused entry here
